item.title: The Design Space of Tri-Modal Masked Diffusion Models
item.description: Discrete diffusion models have emerged as strong alternatives to autoregressive language models, with recent work initializing and finetuning a base unimodal model for bi-modal generation. Diverging from previous approaches, we introduce the first tri-modal Masked Diffusion Models (MDM) pretrained from scratch on text, image-text, and audio-text data. We systematically analyze multimodal scaling laws, modality mixing ratios, noise schedules, batch-size effects and provide optimized inference sam（Apple Machine Learning Research）

item.title: Code-Switching Detection via Language-Selective Dimensions in Speech Foundation Models
item.description: Code-switching (CS), the alternation between languages within an utterance, is common in multilingual speech but underrepresented in pretraining corpora. Increasing CS coverage requires finding relevant utterances in large speech collections so that they can be included in training data. One way to find such utterances is to transcribe the speech and detect language alternation in the text, but this depends on obtaining accurate multilingual transcriptions. item.title: Claude Code 空闲压缩从摘要继续，可用 idleCompaction 关闭并自定义阈值 / It does mean that Claude continues from a summary instead of your full context though. You can turn it off with "idleCompaction": false i...
item.description: Claude Code 的空闲压缩会让 Claude 从摘要而非完整上下文继续。作者说明可在 settings. 中设置 "idleCompaction": false 关闭，并通过 CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_COMPACT_MIN_TOKENS 自定义阈值，默认为 200k。（X：Lydia Hallie（Anthropic，Claude Code） (@lydiahallie)）

item.title: Musk 称 Grok Voice 3.0 登顶 Artificial Analysis 语音模型评测 / Grok Voice 3.0 is now the world’s leading conversational voice model
item.description: Musk 发文称 Grok Voice 3.0 已是全球领先的对话语音模型，并引用 Artificial Analysis 的评测：Grok Voice 3.0 以 86.9 分登顶 Speech to Speech Index，领先 GPT-Live-1（Astra, medium）的 83.2 和 Gemini 3.8 Live 的 82.6，较 Grok Voice 2.0 的 81.3 提升 5.6 分。该模型通过 Realtime API 提供，价格 $0.08 每分钟，Big Bench Audio 平均首音频延迟 0.81 秒，任务成功率 94.8% 居榜首。（X：Elon Musk (@elonmusk, xAI)）
